headline: Waymo suspends freeway rides after California safety ban
summary: California's DMV banned Waymo's self-driving cars from freeways, calling the freeway operations an imminent hazard to public safety after a driverless Waymo was caught trying to pass a Highway Patrol vehicle slowing traffic. Waymo is suspending freeway rides nationwide, and restrictions will stay until it demonstrates effective corrective actions.
